tools.name: ticket
tools.description: Reads a Jira ticket: fields, description, subtasks, links, attachments and comments, as markdown.

tools.name: sprint
tools.description: Lists the tickets of the open sprint of the Jira projects linked to this Squadron project, with their status and assignee.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches Jira with a JQL query and lists up to 50 tickets per Jira site.

jql.description: A JQL query, like project = RING AND status = "In Progress".
